prompt: A wide panoramic landscape of vast open golden grasslands, rolling fields of tall sunlit wheat-gold grass swaying under a low warm dawn sun. A clean distant horizon line splits land and a pale luminous sky streaked with soft peach and cream clouds. Crepuscular rays of warm golden light flood across the plains, the whole scene bathed in the radiant white-gold glow of sunrise. The background is an immense open sky over endless flat plains.

A serene open meadow of pale green and gold grass stretching to a low horizon, beneath a towering bright sky. Brilliant crepuscular rays of pure white-gold sunlight angle down through gaps in high cumulus clouds, pooling radiant light onto the open field. The only source of light is the holy radiant sun breaking through the clouds. The background is a vast luminous sky filled with sunbeams over a wide flat plain.
